columns.title: About US Content
columns.content:
About Us

We live today in a world that is so very different from the one
that we grew up in. Hence, we need to pause and reflect, whether
our schools are well equipped to prepare our children for the
challenges that the future holds for them. Today, there is a
constant need to update and upgrade so as to fill the gaps in
learning. At Delhi Public School Gomti Nagar, we ensure a
well-balanced curriculum so that when these children walk out
of the portals of our school they are ready to face the challenges
of life. Our school has a lot to offer. Properly graded curriculum
for physical education designed by Edu sports is implemented right
from Pre-Primary. Our Sports academy has already won accolades in the
previous year. The animation academy focuses on the enhancement of the
creative skills of children. While promoting academic excellence we
safeguard and nurture the sensitive human being in every child.

Fill out the form above to kickstart the DPS admission process!
